name: modeltrace-guard
description: Background Codex model fingerprint monitoring with disposable forks of a frozen task snapshot.

interface.shortDescription: Background probe · Web dashboard · Proactive mismatch alerts
interface.longDescription: Monitor Codex task fingerprints with English probes in disposable forks of frozen task snapshots. Normal checks run silently in the background. A mismatch prompts notification and additional retries (default 3); if every retry mismatches, the task must stop and supported work tools are blocked. Includes a web dashboard, paginated history, and optional desktop alerts. Probes use the configured Codex account and model and consume inference quota. Scoring uses the bundled offline ModelTrace bank.
interface.defaultPrompt: Enable ModelTrace Guard for this task with English probes and random sampling intervals, and explain how to adjust the frequency.
